title: Sweet and Indulgent Vegan Sweet Potato Soup
description: A comforting and creamy sweet potato soup with an indulgent twist, perfect for a chilly evening. This Syrian-inspired recipe is free from animal products, making it suitable for a vegan diet.
instructions: Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Toss the sweet potatoes with a tablespoon of oil and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes, coconut milk, and nutritional yeast to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the soup has thickened slightly.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
